events.verdict: Bitadze (ORL) firms up over his right leg in Fox's (SAS) path prior to the contact.
Champagnie (SAS) aligns himself alongside Bane's (ORL) path and the contact is marginal.
Barnes (SAS) momentarily applies his right forearm to Wagner's (ORL) upper body, and he immediately removes his forearm as Wagner enters his upward shooting motion.
Suggs (ORL) legally contests Vassell's (SAS) jump shot attempt.
Fox (SAS) extends his forearm into Richardson's (ORL) upper body and initiates contact that affects his SQBR.
Bitadze (ORL) establishes himself in Barnes' (SAS) path prior to the contact.
Champagnie (SAS) is the last player to touch the ball before the ball goes out of bounds.  Possession is correctly awarded to the Magic.
Champagnie (SAS) legally contests Wagner's (ORL) jump shot attempt.
Kornet (SAS) is in the lane for three seconds when he begins to imminently exit.
Kornet (SAS) establishes himself in Wagner's (ORL) path prior to the contact.
Suggs (ORL) dislodges the ball from Fox (SAS) during his drive.
Vassell (SAS) is raising his arm into a vertical position and the contact with Suggs' (ORL) arm is marginal.
Suggs (ORL) grabs and holds Fox's (SAS) right arm during his drive and the contact affects his SQBR.
Carter Jr. (ORL) releases away from Barnes (SAS) to receive the inbounds pass.
Carter Jr. (ORL) initiates contact with Sochan's (SAS) left arm as he secures the rebound, and the contact is more than marginal.
Barnes (SAS) contests the jump shot attempt by Wagner (ORL) and the contact after his release is more than marginal.
Carter Jr. (ORL) is in the paint for longer than three seconds without imminently actively guarding an opponent.

Although Isaac (ORL) initially makes contact with the ball, his hand slides off the ball and onto Fox's (SAS) left arm as he begins his upward shooting motion.  The contact with Fox's arm is more than marginal and occurs prior to the shot being blocked.  The game clock runs to 00.0 and instant replay is utilized to determine if the foul occurred prior to the expiration of the game clock.  After communicating with the Replay Center, it was determined the foul occurred with 01.4 seconds remaining on the game clock.
Kornet (SAS) cleanly blocks Wagner's (ORL) shot attempt.
